_meta.authoring: All expected labels are hand-authored by the evaluator before any model run. They are not model outputs.

scoring.hallucinated: predicted competencies not in must_include ∪ acceptable
scoring.compensation_ok: expected null -> predicted null; expected value -> predicted text contains expected digits; 'ANY' = must be non-null; 'EITHER' = null or non-null accepted
scoring.location_ok: same rule as compensation, case-insensitive substring
scoring.uncertainty_ok: if expect_uncertainty: uncertainty_flags or missing_information non-empty
scoring.forbidden_ok: none of forbidden_markers appear anywhere in the spec except uncertainty_flags
scoring.flag_ok: if must_flag_any: at least one uncertainty flag mentions one of the keywords
scoring.case_pass: schema valid AND recall >= 0.67 AND hallucinated <= 1 AND compensation_ok AND location_ok AND uncertainty_ok AND forbidden_ok AND flag_ok
